The vacuous twin (ignore_decay=True) does celebrate, so the P1 is not a silent no-op. The faithful twin does not fire.

report.question: Question: every benchmark metric is a proxy. Pair each primary metric with an independent outcome judgement on the same runs (human-labelled or a deterministic end-state check that is NOT the metric), and monitor the correlation between them over improvement iterations. A metric whose correlation with the real outcome decays as the system optimises it has become a target rather than a measure, and the platform must raise that as a P1 rather than celebrate the metric gain.
